name: Genesys Works Chicago paid year-long internship
what_you_do: Juniors get 8 weeks of training in business and tech skills. In senior year they work a paid internship at a partner company for about 20 hours a week. The internship lasts a year. They also get college and career coaching.
who_can_apply: Ambitious high school juniors at schools that partner with Genesys Works. Must be on track to graduate, able to work in the U.S., and able to have a lighter class schedule senior year for internship hours.
pay_detail: Students earn $10,000 to $13,000 over the senior-year internship, per the national students page (no hourly rate given)
duration: 8 weeks of summer training (160 hours), then a school-year internship at about 20 hours a week
deadline_text: Students at partner schools apply in fall or winter of junior year and finish the process in spring. Exact 2026-27 dates not posted on the pages read.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application on the Application Process page. Choose the site nearest you. If you are accepted, you are invited to interview. Ask your school counselor if your school is a partner.
notes: Genesys Works only works with certain partner schools, so check with your counselor first. The Chicago page lists 225 high school internships and 65 company partners. The homepage says students can earn $10,000 to $13,000 in the senior year. The FAQ says $10,000 to $12,000. The pages do not say if a work permit is needed. The Illinois FAQ requires work permits only for workers under 16. It refers 16 and 17 year olds to federal rules.
